# Mama Bloom — Pregnancy Tools

> Mama Bloom is a free, private, fast pregnancy companion: a due-date
> calculator, a week-by-week tracker covering all 40 weeks, and a suite of
> friendly calculators. Every calculation runs in the browser — personal data
> never leaves the device. The site is an installable, offline-first
> Progressive Web App. Content is general educational information, not medical
> advice; a healthcare provider's assessment always takes priority.

## Key facts

- A due date is estimated as 40 weeks (280 days) from the first day of the last menstrual period (Naegele's rule), 266 days from conception/ovulation, or adjusted from the transfer date for IVF.
- Only about 1 in 20 babies are born on their exact due date; most arrive within two weeks either side. An early dating ultrasound is usually most accurate.
- Pregnancy is divided into three trimesters: first (weeks 1–13), second (weeks 14–27), and third (weeks 28–40).
- All tools are free, require no account, and work offline once installed.

## Tools

- [Due Date Calculator](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/tools/due-date-calculator/): Estimate your due date from last period, conception, or IVF transfer.
- [Ovulation Calculator](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/tools/ovulation-calculator/): Find your fertile window and likely ovulation day.
- [hCG Doubling Calculator](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/tools/hcg-calculator/): Track the doubling time and daily rise of beta hCG in early pregnancy.
- [Weight Gain Calculator](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/tools/weight-gain-calculator/): Recommended weight-gain range based on pre-pregnancy BMI (IOM guidelines).
- [How Far Along Am I?](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/tools/how-far-along/): Convert a due date into your current week, trimester and days left.
- [Conception Date Calculator](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/tools/conception-date-calculator/): Estimate when conception likely happened.
- [Chinese Gender Predictor](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/tools/chinese-gender-predictor/): A playful traditional chart — just for fun, not science.
- [Contraction Timer](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/tools/contraction-timer/): Time contraction frequency and duration as labour builds.

## Week-by-week guide

- [Pregnancy week by week (all 40 weeks)](https://pregnancyandbaby.tools/pregnancy/): Baby size, symptoms, development and tips for every week.
